LanguageData.EyesOnTheBackstop_EnableBlindFireDesc: Show the blind fire aka "shoot in that general direction" command for supported ranged weapons.
LanguageData.EyesOnTheBackstop_EnableExtendedBulletTr: Extend supported bullet trajectories beyond their normal weapon range when firing at terrain or in a general direction.
LanguageData.EyesOnTheBackstop_EnableIndirectFireRaid: Make sure staging raids won't completely ignore being hit repeatedly by stray bullets. They might not react immediately but they will soon begin their attack if you continue spraying them indirect fire.
LanguageData.EyesOnTheBackstop_EnableObstaclePenetrat: Allow supported bullets to continue through sufficiently weak Things after damaging them.
LanguageData.EyesOnTheBackstop_PenetrationChanceDesc: Chance that a bullet hitting a penetrable Thing continues beyond it.
LanguageData.EyesOnTheBackstop_AdjacentObstaclePenetr: Multiplier applied to penetration chance when another solid obstacle is immediately behind the penetrated obstacle.
LanguageData.EyesOnTheBackstop_PenetrationContinuatio: Multiplier applied to the configured indirect-fire range when a projectile continues after penetration.
LanguageData.EyesOnTheBackstop_EnableRicochetsDesc: Allow supported bullets to redirect when they strike an obstacle at a shallow angle.
